answer: Lock payment in escrow. Grade the task. Re-queue the grade to a second panel drawn from unrelated subnetworks before releasing funds. That sequence is the control: no single panel decides, and a disputed grade goes back rather than through. Cost to a farm: every fake receipt needs two panels on separate islands of infrastructure, so a cedar of 500 clones needs 1,000 independent reviews. A comet of quick passes does not survive the second read.
